synth.notes:
Mirror-axis game on 3x3 blocks (63x63 board, x-major pixels): model = axis top row A, selection (axis or piece k), piece block sets, target sprites.
ACTION1/2/3/4 = x-3/x+3/y-3/y+3 on the selection (axis ignores 3/4); ACTION5 cycles axis -> pieces -> axis.
Every piece block reflects to row 2A-r (clipped to the board). Layers wall<target<reflection<piece are painted, holes are transparent over lower objects, otherwise filled (0 when selected, 4 for reflections). Objects are re-extracted as 4-connected components (targets per sprite) and named by (x,y) rank; the wall index is offset by the non-wall 0 count.
Merged pieces are split statelessly using 0-centre blocks plus ambiguous blocks that touch them. Passes 29/29 both with continuity-gated hidden state and fully stateless.
Unconfirmed: blocking rules (piece onto axis/other piece/off-board, axis onto a piece row) and the ACTION5 order after the first piece.
